question: A cylinder is melted and recast into 8 smaller cylinders of the same height. If the original radius was 6 cm and height 10 cm, find the radius of each small one?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume conserved ⇒ πR²H = 8 × πr²H

Height same ⇒ cancel π and H ⇒ R² = 8r²

r = R ÷ √8 = 6 ÷ (2√2) = 3 ÷ √2

Rationalize ⇒ r = (3√2) ÷ 2

**∴ Answer = (3√2) ÷ 2 cm ≈ 2.12 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Original radius R = 6 cm

Height = 10 cm

Number of cylinders = 8

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder = π × r² × h

 R = 6 cm 8 cylinders 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Original volume = π × 6² × 10

⇒ = π × 36 × 10 = 360π

⇒ Total volume of 8 cylinders = 8 × π × r² × 10

⇒ 360π = 80πr²

⇒ r² = 360 ÷ 80 = 4.5

⇒ r = √4.5 = (3√2) ÷ 2 = 2.12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 2.12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Conservation

When a solid is melted and recast, total volume remains same

Scaling Rule

If number of parts = n and height same, then r ∝ 1 ÷ √n

Cylinder Volume

Volume = π × r² × h

Root Simplification

√4.5 = √(9 ÷ 2) = (3√2) ÷ 2
